name: PlantDoc
description: Real-world plant disease image dataset containing 2,598 images across 13 plant species and 27 healthy/diseased classes, with bounding-box annotations.
citation: Singh, D. et al. PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection. arXiv:1911.10317 (2019). https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10317

license.notes: The upstream PlantDoc-Dataset repository identifies the dataset as CC BY 4.0.
